name: magzhan
description: A personal Claude Code marketplace — plugins for my own projects

plugins.name: stage-pipeline
plugins.description: A staged maker/checker workflow for large UI tasks: splitting into stages, a spec from the design, checks by subagents (Figma/prototype, runtime, code review, dead code, i18n, dependencies), an autonomous force run, a state journal kept in files and a PR description

plugins.name: human-text
plugins.description: Rules for writing work text people actually read (status updates, handoffs, docs) and a closed-question check of a draft in a clean context
